column3: To Refute And Persuade
Hey, make up with each other.
I refuse.
She's completely sulking.
I'll try using "Two-Shot Conversation" to soothe her.
...Even though I was thinking that Senpai was on my side.
...To think that he became Uriel's subordinate... Unbelievable.
Uriel... Are you referring to Kirino?
Yes, indeed.
As the "Fallen Angel", this is my arch-enemy: Uriel.
Really? *gulp*
What was that...
Uri... What's that?
I haven't heard much about it; would you mind explaining it?
U-Um, Uriel is, the fallen angel's, that is, "my" arch-enemy.
Y-Your sister is the host of the spirit that... descended...
...Forget it.
I-I'm sorry.
Ugh, Kuroneko clammed up because of my lousy reaction.
Apparently, this Uriel would be related to Kirino.
Hm-Hmph.
I have nothing to say to a subordinate of Uriel.
Kuroneko, I am not Uriel's subordinate.
Then, what are you?
I am the fallen angel's, that is, your subordinate.
A-Are you stupid?
Don't say that.
You're too long-winded.
The lowly words of a mere human cannot move my heart.
All the while, my magical powers are slowly being released.
The promised end draws near. Soon, everything will be returned to nothingness.
What are you saying...?
...Can it be prevented?!
...Yes. If you wish for it... I may be able to suppress the wild power of darkness.
Urgh, this is so embarrassing!
I wish for it! I'll do everything in my power!
Kukuku... Really, you'll do everything.
Kuroneko... She looks delighted...
...Then, your soul shall be mine for all eternity.
I'm not sure how to react...
...You disappoint me.
I disappointed Kuroneko...
Annoying!
Uwah!
Kirino suddenly appeared!
What are you two going on about?! Caught up in your unhealthy chat are you!
It's annoying just listening to it! Can't you get it over and done with?!
...Oh my, what are you angry about?
Could it be that you are displeased about your brother's soul being taken away from you?
Hah? That's so nonsensical, I don't get it!
Unfortunate. It is time.
Everything has already ended. Everyone will vanish...
Please don't sulk, I'm sorry, okay?
I am not sulking.
